1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 25 m de altura, de copa grande, y tronco corpulento; su fruto es comestible. (Sapotaceae; Manilkara albescens).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 25 m, with a large canopy and stout trunk; its fruit is edible. (Family Sapotaceae; Manilkara albescens).
